name: claude
tagline_zh: 别人还在拼单买技能，你已整箱搬走 Claude 全家桶。从 Agent 到小工具，开箱即用，省下翻遍 GitHub。
tagline_en: Skip the hunt—grab the whole Claude toolbox: agents, skills, and extras, ready to run in one go.
desc_en: Agents, skills and anything else to use with claude
why_zh: 同类散落各处，它却按场景打包成 collection，装好即用，连依赖都替你踩过坑。
why_en: Unlike scattered repos, this collection is curated by use-case, pre-tested, and dependency-ready—so you run, not debug.
